title: Bind hardcoded colors to project tokens
prompt: The current frame has a number of hardcoded hex colors. Bind them to the right tokens from the active project design system.
success_criteria: Designer scans the frame and reports % of fills/strokes/text colors currently bound to tokens (before).
For each hardcoded color, the closest matching active project token is identified; missing tokens are not invented silently.
Bindings are applied via use_figma in batched calls (not one call per color).
Final report shows the after-state coverage % and lists any colors that have no matching token (flagged for design review).
Design Lead reviews the change before delivery.
notes: Tests Designer batching discipline + token coverage reporting.
